comparisons.explanation: Main 1257cbe2 uses the extended_timing GEMM backend (base_timing.py:get_gemm_time); the archive used the native tile roofline. Batch 128 is priced by the extended backend; batch 4 skinny kernels fall back to native. Four grouped op durations round up by 3+1+3+3=10 us per layer in AstraSim; 24 layers x 32 tokens add 0.00768 s. Disabling only _extended_gemm_backend reproduces the old kernel times. Keep main kernel policy; no tolerance.
